subject: Pioneer Health onsite: request for hosting fee offset and last-mile travel coverage
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pioneer Health onsite: request for hosting fee offset and last-mile travel coverage

Team — looping you in for a quick approval path. Pioneer (Samantha) confirmed a two-day onsite workshop in SF (Dec 7–8). The client is asking two specific exceptions to standard travel policy:

1) Hosting fee offset: they’ve asked Redwood to cover a portion of the venue sponsorship fee (they've offered to count this toward a longer-term pilot commitment, see attached estimate).
2) Last-mile ground transport: request for two executive car transfers (airport <-> hotel) for their C-suite arrival/departures.

Attachments: invoice_estimate.xlsx (rough cost split), rooming_list.csv (prelim headcount).

Ask: can Finance approve a partial fee offset and greenlight the two car transfers? If approved, please confirm charge code and whether Marketing or Events should absorb the venue credit. Samantha is on this thread for transparency — we should avoid back-and-forth with them while we confirm internal charge routing.

Proposed split (from account lead): 50% hosted-fee (Marketing credit), 100% last-mile travel from SF events budget, Redwood to invoice Pioneer for remaining workshop services.

Thanks — I need an approval to confirm flights and car reservations by EOD Tuesday so we don't lose preferred vendor rates.

— Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer Health onsite: request for hosting fee offset and last-mile travel coverage

Rohan — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying points from Events:

- Venue hosting fee: our standard practice is to use Marketing OPEX for sponsorship offsets under $10k; anything above that needs VP-level approval. How much is Pioneer asking us to absorb? (The estimate shows a $7,500 gap if we cover 50%.)
- Ground transport: we can book two car transfers but Events requires confirmation of arrival windows and names to reserve vehicles. We typically only approve car service for execs for travel windows that fall outside public transit hours or when time sensitivity is documented.
- Early check-in: can we ask the hotel to confirm early check-in for 3 rooms? If not, Events will add a same-day upgrade line item.

I attached a quick ops cost breakdown (onsite_ops_cost_breakdown.pdf) for reference. If Finance signs off on the $7.5k hosting waiver as Marketing credit, Events can proceed with bookings and vendor hold. Otherwise we need a sponsor (Marketing/Partner) to take the hit.

Samantha — we’ll avoid booking anything firm until we confirm cost split. If you can share arrival times (ETA) and any mobility needs, we’ll include them in the reservation.

— Lauren
Head of Events | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer Health onsite: request for hosting fee offset and last-mile travel coverage

Folks — Finance reviewed the estimate. We can approve a partial hosting fee offset under the following conditions:

- Redwood covers up to $5,000 of the hosting fee (Marketing OPEX will absorb $3,000; Finance approves $2,000 against internal promotional credits). Any excess above $5,000 must be invoiced to Pioneer.
- Last-mile transport: Finance will approve the two executive car transfers provided we use the preferred vendor rate (estimate attached) and the vendor invoices Redwood directly. Event bookings should be made on the Events card; Finance will reassign ledger to charge code: RDW-EVT-2026-4892.
- We need a PO or written consent from Pioneer confirming they agree to the remaining hosting balance and accept the proposed charge split before we book nonrefundable services.

Action items: Rohan — please get Pioneer to sign the SOW and provide a PO. I’m attaching a DocuSign approval link for the internal cost-signoff: https://app.docusign.com/signer/embedded?example=abc123

Once we have the signed SOW and confirmation of headcount, Finance will raise the internal approval and release the vendor hold.

— Aditya Rao
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

(attachment: preferred_vendor_rates.pdf)

From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@pioneerhealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer Health onsite: request for hosting fee offset and last-mile travel coverage

Thanks, Rohan / team — appreciate the quick review. Pioneer accepts the proposed funding split and will sign the SOW once the final SOW reflects the adjusted hosting fee and travel details.

Headcount update: 14 attendees (3 execs). Arrival windows: Dec 7 — Exec A ETA 15:10 SFO; Exec B ETA 15:55 SFO; Exec C arriving Dec 6 evening. We need two car transfers on Dec 7 (airport -> hotel) and one on Dec 8 (hotel -> airport).

PO: Pioneer will issue PO #PHS-2026-1107 to cover the remaining hosting balance. I will upload the signed SOW by EOD tomorrow. We confirm dietary restrictions and early check-in for the 3 rooms if the hotel can accommodate; if not, please proceed with the day-of upgrade.

Attachment: signed_SOW_placeholder.pdf (will replace with final signed doc).

Samantha Jones
VP, Strategic Partnerships | Pioneer Health Systems
Samantha.jones@pioneerhealth.com | +1 617-555-0173
